summary: skill exposure telemetry + deprecation-candidate flag (cinatra#1368, epic #1358 — S10 efficacy loop). Adds two NULLABLE exposure-telemetry columns to the per-run usage ledger agent_run_skills_used: delivery_mode (how the skill reached the model on the resolving step — openai_shell | gemini_inline | anthropic_container | personal_inline; NULL = the sessionless run-start snapshot whose mode is not yet known) and invocation_attributable (whether that mode can attribute a per-skill invocation — only openai_shell is today; a skill exposed only via NULL/non-attributable rows can never become a deprecation candidate). Adds a plain (non-unique) skill_id index serving the per-skill exposure/invocation rollup. Adds one NULLABLE column to skills: deprecation_candidate_dismissed_at (the human 'reviewed — keep it' decision clearing an exposed-but-never-invoked skill from the candidate list without deprecating it; the positive decision remains the existing lifecycle transition to 'deprecated'). Gate class NON-destructive (additive): nullable columns + a non-unique index on existing tables (no NOT NULL, no unique index, no constraint, no data rewrite). Mirrors the idempotent bootstrap DDL in buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries (fresh-bootstrap and operator-upgrade aligned; core__0034 precedent) — shipped as the optional artifact the convention allows alongside additive changes so the ledger + upgrade proof stay complete. down() drops the index then the columns (exposure telemetry + dismissal decisions written after up() are lost on --down; the shipped invocation_count column is untouched).
